scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @thunder-uno/shared-types build && corepack pnpm --filter @thunder-uno/uno-core build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @thunder-uno/shared-types build && corepack pnpm --filter @thunder-uno/uno-core build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @thunder-uno/shared-types build && corepack pnpm --filter @thunder-uno/uno-core build && vitest run
scripts.simulate: corepack pnpm --filter @thunder-uno/shared-types build && corepack pnpm --filter @thunder-uno/uno-core build && tsx src/cli.ts simulate
scripts.batch: corepack pnpm --filter @thunder-uno/shared-types build && corepack pnpm --filter @thunder-uno/uno-core build && tsx src/cli.ts batch
